  order 1/m^0: leading nu^0 coefficient - bulk-point expansion = 0
  order 1/m^2: leading nu^2 coefficient - bulk-point expansion = 0
  order 1/m^4: leading nu^4 coefficient - bulk-point expansion = 0
  order 1/m^6: leading nu^6 coefficient - bulk-point expansion = 0
  order 1/m^8: leading nu^8 coefficient - bulk-point expansion = 0
